build_config: how you built it: compiler + version, important flags/options

cells.input_class: a name for one kind of input you ran, e.g. normal
cells.execution: CLEAN, BUG, or NOTRIGGER (the line was never reached)
cells.result: certify_clean | clean does NOT transfer | checker missed a real bug | not covered

control_grade: controlled (you showed your test CAN fail on a planted bug) or uncontrolled
note: anything a reader needs to know to reproduce this
